title: Cientista de dados
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Responsabilidades

Liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de modelos estatísticos e preditivos avançados;

Atuar em desafios complexos de análise preditiva e modelagem customizada;

Propor melhorias, inovações e novas abordagens de modelagem;

Avaliar, validar e aprimorar modelos existentes;

Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time;

Garantir aderência técnica e alinhamento dos modelos às necessidades de negócio e ao ciclo de crédito.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

Ensino superior completo em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharias, Física ou áreas correlatas;

Conhecimento avançado em estatística, machine learning e modelagem preditiva;

Ampla experiência em manipulação e análise de dados;

Forte domínio de programação (Python e/ou R);

Conhecimento sólido do ciclo de crédito;

Capacidade de atuar com autonomia técnica e tomada de decisão.


Formato de trabalho: Home office


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Solutions Architect
description:
JDA WMS Developer

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior JDA Warehouse Management System (WMS) Solution Architect to lead end to end solution design, integration, and delivery for global transformational programs. This role requires deep functional and technical expertise in JDA WMS (Discrete), exceptional communication skills, and the ability to operate in fast paced, multi vendor environments.

You will act as the primary JDA WMS expert across strategic initiatives, driving architecture, process optimization, integration design, and overall solution governance.

Desired Skills & Experience

• Bachelor’s or higher degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or Logistics.

• Strong hands-on experience with JDA Warehouse Management System (Discrete).

• Participation in 2–3 full end to end implementation projects.

• Strong domain knowledge of JDA WMS configuration, design, and delivery to support customer business processes.

• Extensive experience designing current and future-state architecture for enterprise clients.

• Deep expertise in:

o MOCA Components

o MTF

o DDA/Page Builder

o Reports & Labels

• Strong experience integrating JDA WMS with multiple host/destination systems using JDA Integrator/Connect.

• Hands-on experience with WCS, TMS, and Parcel integrations (any).

• Experience developing/modifying interfaces, tracing, debugging, and troubleshooting.

• Experience using support tools, project management tools, and global SharePoint.

• Knowledge of middleware integration methods (JDA Connect, MuleSoft, TIBCO).

• Solid understanding of SDLC, requirement analysis, and solution design.

• Experience working in dynamic, fast-paced, multi-vendor environments.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Strong positive attitude, ownership mindset, and focus on process improvement.

Key Responsibilities

• Actively participate in Solution Design workshops and lead end-to-end solution architecture discussions.

• Approve solution designs and validate the configured JDA WMS solution.

• Validate test concepts, test scenarios, and user acceptance criteria.

• Serve as the primary JDA WMS expert for global transformation projects and programs.

• Lead Change Management activities for global or regional implementations.

• Contribute to the Global Technology Strategy and present technical assessments to governance boards for rapid decision-making.

• Prepare and deliver presentations to users, management, and executive-level audiences.

• Advise customers on industry best practices and process methodology.

• Demonstrate and facilitate design, development, and integration discussions covering product functionality and architecture.

• Ensure smooth integration between technical and functional requirements across JDA modules.

• Proactively identify process improvement opportunities and ensure alignment with business stakeholders.

• Collaborate with Business, Service Delivery, and Service Providers in evaluating and approving new solutions.

• Drive improvements in global technology processes and service delivery.

• Translate business requirements into technical specifications and functional designs.

• Lead business process analysis, design, construction, validation, and deployment phases.

Required Qualifications

• CCNP Certification (Required)

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or a related field.

• Advanced English


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Coordenador(a) de Seleção Molecular
description:
Estamos em busca de um Coordenador(a) de Seleção Molecular para compor o nosso time de P&D.


Buscamos um profissional para coordenar a área de Seleção Molecular, assegurando excelência técnica, integração no pipeline GM e formação de um time de alta performance.


Principais responsabilidades:

· Estruturar e desenvolver um time multidisciplinar de alto desempenho, promovendo crescimento técnico e organizacional de pesquisadores e assistentes.

· Garantir retenção e atração de talentos estratégicos para a área.

· Gerir orçamento e priorização de recursos, alinhados às diretrizes estratégicas e à cultura CAIS.


Assegurar excelência técnica e integração das quatro frentes da Seleção Molecular:

I. Seleção de eventos transgênicos por meio da caracterização completa de proteínas de interesse.

II. Seleção de eventos transgênicos e stewardship via caracterização genômica completa.

III. Produção e purificação de moléculas para descoberta de novos traits.

IV. Preparo de inóculos bacterianos e controle de qualidade para transformação vegetal.


Interface e articulação estratégica: a posição exige forte capacidade de articulação transversal, garantindo alinhamento com todas as etapas do pipeline GM e com diferentes stakeholders, incluindo interfaces no Brasil, EUA (Genomics) e parceiros externos.


Local e atuação

· Piracicaba SP


Benefícios da posição:

· Participação nos Resultados

· Assistência Médica

· Assistência Odontológica

· Auxílio Medicamento

· Seguro de Vida

· Previdência Privada

· Alimentação: Restaurante no CTC

· Fretado – Piracicaba ou Campinas

· Gympass / Wellhub


No CTC - Centro de Tecnologia Canavieira, cada dia é uma oportunidade de expandir os limites da genética e do manejo da cana-de-açúcar, desenvolvendo soluções inovadoras para um mundo mais sustentável.


Por que escolher o CTC?

Liderança global em inovação: Estamos na vanguarda das pesquisas com cana-de-açúcar, utilizando as técnicas mais avançadas de melhoramento genético e biotecnologia para criar o mais completo portifólio de variedades.

Infraestrutura de ponta: Nossa sede em Piracicaba (SP) abriga laboratórios reconhecidos como os mais modernos do país. Além de mais de 40 polos de experimentação espalhados pelo Brasil, contamos também com um centro de pesquisa em Saint-Louis (Missouri, EUA).

Equipe apaixonada e dedicada: Nosso time é movido pela ciência e pelo propósito de superar os desafios do setor, garantindo excelência e inovação no campo.


Nossa Cultura:

Colaboração ágil: Atuamos de forma colaborativa, sem perder a agilidade e valorizamos a troca de conhecimento.

Alta performance: Entregamos resultados de muito valor, com alto nível de excelência na execução.

Atitude inovadora: Transformamos ideias em soluções de alto impacto, aplicadas de forma ágil e prática. Estamos sempre em busca de soluções que transformem o agro e coloquem o cliente no centro de nossas ações.

Sucesso do Cliente: Por meio de nossas soluções, geramos valor e resultado para os nossos clientes. O cliente está no centro de nossas decisões e o sucesso dos nossos clientes é o nosso sucesso.

Se você é movido pela ciência, pela inovação e quer causar um impacto real, o CTC é o lugar certo para você. Candidate-se agora e seja parte dessa transformação! Junte-se a um time em pleno crescimento exponencial, onde seu desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional têm espaço para acontecer. Venha construir com a gente um futuro sustentável e descarbonizado.

title: Analista de empréstimo
description:
About Monee

At Monee, we believe that every team member is essential to our success — and that diversity of perspectives and experiences is key to driving our business and advancing our purpose of changing the world for the better.

Being part of our team means growing within a fast-paced and agile culture. If you love taking on big responsibilities and doing what has never been done before, Monee is the place for you.

Here, you’ll face meaningful challenges, collaborate with a diverse team, and help shape the future of the fintech industry in Brazil — creating a positive impact in the lives of millions.

Work Model

We adopt a hybrid work model, this model allows people to adjust their work environment according to their personal needs, while promoting collaboration and interaction in the office.



What will be your mission?

Planning and execution of projects related to credit products, including participation in and development of initiatives focused on identifying business opportunities, conducting in-depth analyses, and implementing new solutions. Creation of strategic initiatives aimed at driving growth and cost reduction. Leadership of workstreams within high-impact projects in a fast-paced environment, ensuring concrete and tangible deliverables. Ongoing interaction with teams across different areas and countries, as well as direct collaboration with multiple internal stakeholders and external partners.


What will your day-to-day be like?

  • Build and launch new credit products (with focus on consumer) while monitoring the results of current product portfolio;
  • Identify business opportunities, conduct in-depth analysis, and implement new solutions;
  • Prepare and present business cases to both local and international audiences
  • Own and deliver strategic and tactical initiatives to drive growth and cost reduction;
  • Lead workstreams in high-impact projects in a fast-paced environment, with concrete and tangible deliverables;
  • Interact with teams from different areas and countries. Work closely with the SG SeaMoney team.
  • High exposure to top management.



What you need to take on the challenge:

  • Experience in Credit Products for Consumers (BNPL, Personal Loan, Secured Credit etc.)
  • Advanced English (speaking, reading, and writing is mandatory);
  • Hands-on profile, ability to think strategically;
  • Data-drive profile, being capable of dealing with complex models and analysis;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with cross-functional teams and external

stakeholders;

  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Benefits:
  • Medical and dental care, extended to dependents;
  • Partnership with Gympass and TotalPass;
  • Flexible meal/food vouchers;
  • Transportation vouchers, mobility vouchers or on-site parking;
  • Flexible benefits;
  • Zenklub;
  • Discretionary annual bonus, linked to performance.

COME MAKE HISTORY WITH US.

WHAT MAKES YOU UNIQUE, MAKES US BETTER!

title: Senior API Engineer (NodeJS, TS, SDUI)
description:
About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role summary:

Lead the design and operation of APIs that power Server-Driven UI for Flutter clients while owning backend services across the stack. You’ll design stable UI contracts and compose client payloads, be comfortable diving into other backend codebases to implement features and fix production issues, participate in the on-call rotation to keep services healthy and low-latency, and drive team capability for SDUI.


Key responsibilities:

  • Design and implement robust RESTful APIs for SDUI, auth, and rate limiting.
  • Implement composition/templating logic that returns client-ready UI payloads with capability-aware fallbacks.
  • Champion SDUI capability across the team: coach engineers, run hands-on workshops, create onboarding/docs, and promote SDUI best practices.
  • Work across multiple backend repositories: add features, refactor, and maintain code quality.
  • Operate production services: own SLAs, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and participate in on-call rotation.
  • Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing).
  • Build and maintain CI/CD, testing, and observability (metrics, tracing, logs, dashboards).
  • Integrate personalization, experimentation hooks, and feature flags into the delivery flow.
  • Collaborate closely with mobile/web teams to define contracts and client compatibility.
  • Mentor peers, lead design reviews, and drive API and schema governance and backward-compatibility practices.


Required skills & experience:

  • 7+ years building production microservices and APIs.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with active participation in team ceremonies and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design.
  • Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) experience, including effective use of abstraction and dependency injection patterns to build modular, testable, and maintainable backend systems.
  • Hands-on development in TypeScript for backend services.
  • Proven RESTful API design and contract experience.
  • Solid experience with databases and caching technologies, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis, with an understanding of data modeling, query performance, and cache strategies.
  • Strong with AWS (API Gateway/Lambda or ECS/EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents).
  • Experience with containerization using Docker (image build, Docker Compose, registries, running services in containers).
  • Strong testing experience, including automated testing and manual verification.
  • Experience with production support: alerting, runbooks, incident management, and on-call duties.
  • Familiar with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, etc.).
  • Good spoken English


Nice to have:

  • Terraform or other IaC for managing AWS resources.
  • Experience instrumenting endpoints and surfacing behavior in analytics platforms such as Amplitude (event schemas, dashboards, alerts).
  • Experience using Statsig, Grafana, and Sentry for experimentation, dashboards, error tracking, and incident diagnostics.
  • Protobuf experience (service/event schema management via service-protos).
  • Background in personalization/experimentation systems.
  • Hands-on development in Python for backend services.


Hiring signals:

  • Examples of evolving APIs without breaking clients and measurable reliability/performance improvements.
  • Proven track record of mentoring and up-skilling engineers—especially enabling teams to adopt and own SDUI patterns.
  • Evidence of effective on-call ownership: resolved incidents, improved runbooks/alerts, postmortems.
  • Code that shows strong testing, observability, and cross-repo contributions.


Perks:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work
  • Flexible PTO
  • Global offices
  • Fun, positive, collaborative environment!



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: SiteCore Developer
description:
We are looking for a Sitecore Developer Developer for a 100% Remote, 5 month +, 1099 contract


Location: Brazil or Colombia, South America (work remote supporting US based client/project)

Employment Type: Contract Work, 40 hours weekly


Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Sitecore Developer to design, develop, and support enterprise-level CMS and commerce platforms. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Sitecore 8 and 9.x , C# , and the .NET Framework , with a proven ability to build scalable, high-performance solutions in complex enterprise environments.

This role involves working on both modernization initiatives and ongoing support of legacy Sitecore implementations while ensuring code quality, scalability, and system reliability.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop Sitecore MVC solutions for enterprise CMS and commerce platforms
  • Build and maintain custom Sitecore APIs and integrations
  • Support and modernize legacy Sitecore environments
  • Ensure application performance, scalability, and code quality best practices
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver robust digital solutions
  • Contribute to Sitecore version upgrades and platform migrations


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Extensive experience developing Sitecore MVC solutions in enterprise environments
  • Strong hands-on experience with Sitecore 8 and Sitecore 9.3
  • Experience with Sitecore Commerce (add-on)
  • Proficiency in C# and .NET Framework
  • Experience working with Sitecore APIs
  • Experience developing or supporting Azure web services (JavaScript-based)
  • Proven experience maintaining and upgrading legacy Sitecore platforms

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience migrating between Sitecore versions
  • Experience with Node.js migrations
  • Familiarity with Azure cloud environments and deployment best practices
  • SiteCore Certifications

title: SAP BTP CAP Developer
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. É por isso que estamos sempre em busca de profissionais experientes e em início de carreira para se juntarem à nossa equipe.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Estamos em busca de um(a) SAP BTP CAP Developer para atuar no desenvolvimento de aplicações cloud nativas, integrações e extensões SAP utilizando o Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP) dentro da SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) para integrar nossa equipe de Nearshore.


Responsabilidade:


  • Desenvolver aplicações SAP BTP utilizando CAP (Node.js ou Java), CDS, serviços OData e lógica de negócios em cloud.
  • Criar e manter extensões side-by-side para sistemas SAP S/4HANA.
  • Projetar modelos de dados com CDS e implementar serviços, handlers e integrações.
  • Trabalhar com SAP HANA Cloud, XSUAA, Destinations, Approuter e demais serviços gerenciados da BTP.
  • Construir e manter pipelines CI/CD, testes automatizados e documentação técnica.
  • Atuar em correções, troubleshooting e performance de aplicações CAP.


Requisitos :

  • Experiência comprovada com SAP BTP e desenvolvimento com CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model).
  • Domínio de Node.js (ou Java) para desenvolvimento CAP.
  • Conhecimento em CDS, OData, Fiori Elements e annotations.
  • Experiência com SAP HANA Cloud: modelagem, consultas e performance.


Diferenciais:

  • Certificações SAP BTP (Developer, Extension Suite, Integration Suite, CAP).
  • Experiência com SAP Fiori Elements e UI5 freestyle.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Participação em projetos internacionais ou ambientes multiculturais


Formato de Trabalho: Remoto

Contratação: CLT

title: Mid/Senior Devops
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join a strategic cloud migration initiative, transitioning workloads from Azure to AWS within a structured modernization program.

This professional will play a key role in supporting the technical execution of the migration, ensuring infrastructure standardization, automation, CI/CD pipeline implementation, environment readiness, observability, and post-migration operational validation.


The project follows a Lift & Shift / Replatform approach, covering infrastructure preparation, security, networking, service equivalency mapping, migration execution, testing, stabilization, and post-cutover operational readiness.


Key Responsibilities


  • Prepare and standardize AWS environments (VPC, IAM, networking, security, logging).
  • Support migrations using AWS MGN, DMS, and SCT.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
  • Manage Infrastructure as Code with Terraform.
  • Implement monitoring and observability (CloudWatch, X-Ray, Grafana).
  • Validate application, database, and network functionality post-migration.
  • Support performance, scalability, and security testing.
  • Contribute to documentation and runbooks.


What do you need to know?


  • Cloud & Migration: AWS (EC2, EKS/ECS, S3, Aurora, VPC, ALB/NLB, Route 53, IAM, KMS), Azure (VMs, AKS, SQL, App Services)
  • DevOps & Automation: Terraform, Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps), Python/Bash/PowerShell
  • Migration Tools: AWS MGN, DMS, SCT
  • Integrations & Monitoring: Kafka, Snowflake, Elasticsearch, Datadog
  • Language: Fluent English


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the AI/R Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 5 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You

  • You’re a full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 3+ years of experience.
  • You’re a product-minded engineer with a pragmatic approach to building software.
  • You write expressive readable and maintainable code instead of just hacking together something that only works.
  • You’re curious about IoT, WiFi and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.
  • You want to learn how a business operates and get exposure beyond just writing code.


About the Role

  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Javascript and deploy it via Heroku.
  • Work with the CTO to break down large projects into small shippable slices and execute on those projects.
  • Build API integrations with 3rd party software providers
  • Create intelligent scripts and integrations to automate WiFi management tasks
  • Create and review pull requests in Github.


Why Work at StayFi?

  • You’ll be working directly with the CTO and CEO on mission critical projects.
  • You’ll get mentorship directly from the CTO and senior engineers who can help you go from being a junior or mid-level engineer to being a true master.
  • As you continue to do good work and help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to learn the ins and outs of running a sustainable and growing business.
  • You’ll be working on a small team, so you’ll get the chance to have a large impact within our company and in the vacation rental industry at large.


Location

  • Join our fully remote team from anywhere in the world. title: Product Owner – Jornadas, Serviços & IA (Omnichannel)
description:
Sobre a vaga


Nós da Neppo , empresa do Grupo Sankhya , temos uma grande oportunidade para você, que quer atuar como Product Owner , para atuar em jornadas, serviços & IA com foco em Omnichannel. Buscamos alguém que vá além do operacional e tenha apetite para protagonizar a construção e evolução de jornadas de atendimento, vendas e suporte, combinando IA, automação e processos tradicionais. Aqui, você terá alta exposição, contato direto com os clientes e espaço real para influenciar decisões estratégicas, impactando diretamente a experiência dos clientes e os resultados do negócio.


Atuando desde 2009 em Uberlândia (MG) , na Neppo somos antenados, ligados em tecnologia e em relacionamentos próximos e duradouros entre pessoas e empresas. Vivemos e respiramos criatividade e colaboração, por isso estamos sempre abertos a novos modelos de negócios e parcerias. Trabalhamos sob as premissas de liberdade, criatividade, transparência, comprometimento e inovação tecnológica.


Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho leve, em que nosso time tenha autonomia e flexibilidade. Nossos Neppers e parceiros são o que temos de mais valioso, por isso, estamos sempre pensando em como tornar a Neppo um lugar melhor para nosso time. Buscamos pessoas com iniciativa, sede de conhecimento, dedicação e vontade de crescer!


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Ser responsável pela demanda do cliente, com autonomia para influenciar decisões estratégicas e evoluções da jornada do cliente(Chatbot e agentes de IA).
  • Desenhar, evoluir e escalar jornadas de atendimento e vendas , utilizando IA, automação e fluxos low code.
  • Traduzir problemas reais de negócio e operação em comunicações inteligentes que gerem valor para usuários e impacto para a empresa.
  • Atuar de forma prática na construção de fluxos e jornadas utilizando a ferramenta low code da Neppo.
  • Conduzir projetos mais complexos que envolvam integrações com sistemas internos e externos, utilizando componentes de integração e chamadas a APIs.
  • Conectar contexto de mercado, experiência do usuário e viabilidade técnica nas discussões das jornadas de agentes.
  • Avaliar impactos das decisões do cliente no negócio, priorizando iniciativas com maior potencial de resultado e aplicando as melhores práticas de CX.
  • Atuar além da execução, provocando evoluções contínuas na forma de pensar, construir e entregar as jornadas dentro da área de Serviços.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência prévia como Product Owner ou papel similar, atuando sobre produto, soluções ou projetos saas.
  • Conhecimento sólido em APIs REST, com capacidade de dialogar com engenharia sobre integrações, limitações técnicas e impactos das decisões de produto.
  • Vivência em contextos que envolvam low code/no code, entendendo suas possibilidades, limitações e impactos na escalabilidade.
  • Capacidade de atuar em cenários híbridos: automação + processos tradicionais.
  • Forte orientação à experiência do usuário, com habilidade para mapear, analisar e evoluir jornadas complexas.
  • Experiência na construção, priorização e gestão de backlog, conectando objetivos de negócio, necessidades do usuário e viabilidade técnica.
  • Perfil analítico, com facilidade para transformar problemas de negócio em soluções de jornadas que geram experiência e eficiência para as empresas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de apoio à construção de jornadas, como Miro, ou similares.


Seria legal se você tivesse


  • Vivência em ambiente de Desenvolvimento de Software.


Localidade | Atuação


Uberlândia/MG: Híbrido

Demais localidades: Remoto


Informações adicionais


Na Neppo , prezamos muito pelo equilíbrio entre o lado profissional e pessoal. Sabemos que hoje tudo é interligado e, no fim das contas, é tudo sobre gente . Por isso, nossos benefícios são personalizados para Neppers , confira:


⏱Horários Flexíveis

title: Account Manager
description:
• LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
  • WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
  • BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?


Oneday is a VC-backed EdTech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.


We have raised $20M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.


We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.


What you’ll do..

As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest
  • Understand what they’re building, why it matters, and where they’re stuck
  • Clearly position Oneday’s programs and mentorship
  • Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
  • Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
  • Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
  • Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates


This is not a passive customer success role.

It’s a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.


You’ll likely do well here if you:

  • Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
  • Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
  • Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
  • Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
  • Take feedback well and apply it
  • Have strong written and spoken English skills
  • Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results


What you’ll get:

  • Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
  • Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

title: Solutions Architect
description:
JDA WMS Developer

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior JDA Warehouse Management System (WMS) Solution Architect to lead end to end solution design, integration, and delivery for global transformational programs. This role requires deep functional and technical expertise in JDA WMS (Discrete), exceptional communication skills, and the ability to operate in fast paced, multi vendor environments.

You will act as the primary JDA WMS expert across strategic initiatives, driving architecture, process optimization, integration design, and overall solution governance.

Desired Skills & Experience

• Bachelor’s or higher degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or Logistics.

• Strong hands-on experience with JDA Warehouse Management System (Discrete).

• Participation in 2–3 full end to end implementation projects.

• Strong domain knowledge of JDA WMS configuration, design, and delivery to support customer business processes.

• Extensive experience designing current and future-state architecture for enterprise clients.

• Deep expertise in:

o MOCA Components

o MTF

o DDA/Page Builder

o Reports & Labels

• Strong experience integrating JDA WMS with multiple host/destination systems using JDA Integrator/Connect.

• Hands-on experience with WCS, TMS, and Parcel integrations (any).

• Experience developing/modifying interfaces, tracing, debugging, and troubleshooting.

• Experience using support tools, project management tools, and global SharePoint.

• Knowledge of middleware integration methods (JDA Connect, MuleSoft, TIBCO).

• Solid understanding of SDLC, requirement analysis, and solution design.

• Experience working in dynamic, fast-paced, multi-vendor environments.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Strong positive attitude, ownership mindset, and focus on process improvement.

Key Responsibilities

• Actively participate in Solution Design workshops and lead end-to-end solution architecture discussions.

• Approve solution designs and validate the configured JDA WMS solution.

• Validate test concepts, test scenarios, and user acceptance criteria.

• Serve as the primary JDA WMS expert for global transformation projects and programs.

• Lead Change Management activities for global or regional implementations.

• Contribute to the Global Technology Strategy and present technical assessments to governance boards for rapid decision-making.

• Prepare and deliver presentations to users, management, and executive-level audiences.

• Advise customers on industry best practices and process methodology.

• Demonstrate and facilitate design, development, and integration discussions covering product functionality and architecture.

• Ensure smooth integration between technical and functional requirements across JDA modules.

• Proactively identify process improvement opportunities and ensure alignment with business stakeholders.

• Collaborate with Business, Service Delivery, and Service Providers in evaluating and approving new solutions.

• Drive improvements in global technology processes and service delivery.

• Translate business requirements into technical specifications and functional designs.

• Lead business process analysis, design, construction, validation, and deployment phases.

Required Qualifications

• CCNP Certification (Required)

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or a related field.

• Advanced English

title: Analista de empréstimo
description:
About Monee

At Monee, we believe that every team member is essential to our success — and that diversity of perspectives and experiences is key to driving our business and advancing our purpose of changing the world for the better.

Being part of our team means growing within a fast-paced and agile culture. If you love taking on big responsibilities and doing what has never been done before, Monee is the place for you.

Here, you’ll face meaningful challenges, collaborate with a diverse team, and help shape the future of the fintech industry in Brazil — creating a positive impact in the lives of millions.

Work Model

We adopt a hybrid work model, this model allows people to adjust their work environment according to their personal needs, while promoting collaboration and interaction in the office.



What will be your mission?

Planning and execution of projects related to credit products, including participation in and development of initiatives focused on identifying business opportunities, conducting in-depth analyses, and implementing new solutions. Creation of strategic initiatives aimed at driving growth and cost reduction. Leadership of workstreams within high-impact projects in a fast-paced environment, ensuring concrete and tangible deliverables. Ongoing interaction with teams across different areas and countries, as well as direct collaboration with multiple internal stakeholders and external partners.


What will your day-to-day be like?

  • Build and launch new credit products (with focus on consumer) while monitoring the results of current product portfolio;
  • Identify business opportunities, conduct in-depth analysis, and implement new solutions;
  • Prepare and present business cases to both local and international audiences
  • Own and deliver strategic and tactical initiatives to drive growth and cost reduction;
  • Lead workstreams in high-impact projects in a fast-paced environment, with concrete and tangible deliverables;
  • Interact with teams from different areas and countries. Work closely with the SG SeaMoney team.
  • High exposure to top management.



What you need to take on the challenge:

  • Experience in Credit Products for Consumers (BNPL, Personal Loan, Secured Credit etc.)
  • Advanced English (speaking, reading, and writing is mandatory);
  • Hands-on profile, ability to think strategically;
  • Data-drive profile, being capable of dealing with complex models and analysis;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with cross-functional teams and external

stakeholders;

  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Benefits:
  • Medical and dental care, extended to dependents;
  • Partnership with Gympass and TotalPass;
  • Flexible meal/food vouchers;
  • Transportation vouchers, mobility vouchers or on-site parking;
  • Flexible benefits;
  • Zenklub;
  • Discretionary annual bonus, linked to performance.

COME MAKE HISTORY WITH US.

WHAT MAKES YOU UNIQUE, MAKES US BETTER!

title: Senior API Engineer (NodeJS, TS, SDUI)
description:
About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role summary:

Lead the design and operation of APIs that power Server-Driven UI for Flutter clients while owning backend services across the stack. You’ll design stable UI contracts and compose client payloads, be comfortable diving into other backend codebases to implement features and fix production issues, participate in the on-call rotation to keep services healthy and low-latency, and drive team capability for SDUI.


Key responsibilities:

  • Design and implement robust RESTful APIs for SDUI, auth, and rate limiting.
  • Implement composition/templating logic that returns client-ready UI payloads with capability-aware fallbacks.
  • Champion SDUI capability across the team: coach engineers, run hands-on workshops, create onboarding/docs, and promote SDUI best practices.
  • Work across multiple backend repositories: add features, refactor, and maintain code quality.
  • Operate production services: own SLAs, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and participate in on-call rotation.
  • Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing).
  • Build and maintain CI/CD, testing, and observability (metrics, tracing, logs, dashboards).
  • Integrate personalization, experimentation hooks, and feature flags into the delivery flow.
  • Collaborate closely with mobile/web teams to define contracts and client compatibility.
  • Mentor peers, lead design reviews, and drive API and schema governance and backward-compatibility practices.


Required skills & experience:

  • 7+ years building production microservices and APIs.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with active participation in team ceremonies and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design.
  • Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) experience, including effective use of abstraction and dependency injection patterns to build modular, testable, and maintainable backend systems.
  • Hands-on development in TypeScript for backend services.
  • Proven RESTful API design and contract experience.
  • Solid experience with databases and caching technologies, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis, with an understanding of data modeling, query performance, and cache strategies.
  • Strong with AWS (API Gateway/Lambda or ECS/EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents).
  • Experience with containerization using Docker (image build, Docker Compose, registries, running services in containers).
  • Strong testing experience, including automated testing and manual verification.
  • Experience with production support: alerting, runbooks, incident management, and on-call duties.
  • Familiar with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, etc.).
  • Good spoken English


Nice to have:

  • Terraform or other IaC for managing AWS resources.
  • Experience instrumenting endpoints and surfacing behavior in analytics platforms such as Amplitude (event schemas, dashboards, alerts).
  • Experience using Statsig, Grafana, and Sentry for experimentation, dashboards, error tracking, and incident diagnostics.
  • Protobuf experience (service/event schema management via service-protos).
  • Background in personalization/experimentation systems.
  • Hands-on development in Python for backend services.


Hiring signals:

  • Examples of evolving APIs without breaking clients and measurable reliability/performance improvements.
  • Proven track record of mentoring and up-skilling engineers—especially enabling teams to adopt and own SDUI patterns.
  • Evidence of effective on-call ownership: resolved incidents, improved runbooks/alerts, postmortems.
  • Code that shows strong testing, observability, and cross-repo contributions.


Perks:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work
  • Flexible PTO
  • Global offices
  • Fun, positive, collaborative environment!



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Omnistudio Developer
description:
Salesforce Developer – OmniStudio & Communications Cloud


The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and delivering scalable and high‑quality Salesforce solutions within a digital transformation project in the telecommunications industry. You will work with OmniStudio, Salesforce Communications Cloud, and core Salesforce technologies to build optimized business processes. You will test your code, ensure quality through best practices, and collaborate in Agile environments.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement scalable solutions using OmniStudio (OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures).
  • Build and configure applications within Salesforce Communications Cloud (formerly Vlocity CPQ/EPC).
  • Participate in the development of telecom business processes such as quote‑to‑order , customer onboarding , and service provisioning .
  • Write clear, maintainable, and high‑quality code using Apex , LWC , and Salesforce configuration tools.
  • Support integration development using REST, SOAP, JSON, XML .
  • Collaborate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, estimation, and reviews.
  • Perform unit testing and provide support throughout SIT and UAT cycles.
  • Document technical specifications, solution designs, and deployment guidelines.
  • Contribute to CI/CD workflows using tools such as Copado, Git, Jenkins, Ant .


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands‑on experience with Salesforce development .
  • 2+ years of experience with OmniStudio development.
  • Strong experience with:
  • OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures
  • Salesforce configuration, Apex , and LWC
  • Salesforce Communications Cloud (Vlocity CPQ & EPC)
  • Experience integrating systems using REST/SOAP APIs and working with JSON/XML formats.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Copado, Git, Jenkins, Ant).
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments (SAFe Agile preferred).
  • Strong debugging, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.


Preferred Certifications

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I
  • OmniStudio Developer Certification
  • Salesforce Industries CPQ Developer (nice to have)

title: SiteCore Developer
description:
We are looking for a Sitecore Developer Developer for a 100% Remote, 5 month +, 1099 contract


Location: Brazil or Colombia, South America (work remote supporting US based client/project)

Employment Type: Contract Work, 40 hours weekly


Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Sitecore Developer to design, develop, and support enterprise-level CMS and commerce platforms. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Sitecore 8 and 9.x , C# , and the .NET Framework , with a proven ability to build scalable, high-performance solutions in complex enterprise environments.

This role involves working on both modernization initiatives and ongoing support of legacy Sitecore implementations while ensuring code quality, scalability, and system reliability.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop Sitecore MVC solutions for enterprise CMS and commerce platforms
  • Build and maintain custom Sitecore APIs and integrations
  • Support and modernize legacy Sitecore environments
  • Ensure application performance, scalability, and code quality best practices
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver robust digital solutions
  • Contribute to Sitecore version upgrades and platform migrations


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Extensive experience developing Sitecore MVC solutions in enterprise environments
  • Strong hands-on experience with Sitecore 8 and Sitecore 9.3
  • Experience with Sitecore Commerce (add-on)
  • Proficiency in C# and .NET Framework
  • Experience working with Sitecore APIs
  • Experience developing or supporting Azure web services (JavaScript-based)
  • Proven experience maintaining and upgrading legacy Sitecore platforms

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience migrating between Sitecore versions
  • Experience with Node.js migrations
  • Familiarity with Azure cloud environments and deployment best practices
  • SiteCore Certifications

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop Sitecore MVC solutions for enterprise CMS and commerce platforms
  • Build and maintain custom Sitecore APIs and integrations
  • Support and modernize legacy Sitecore environments
  • Ensure application performance, scalability, and code quality best practices
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver robust digital solutions
  • Contribute to Sitecore version upgrades and platform migrations


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Extensive experience developing Sitecore MVC solutions in enterprise environments
  • Strong hands-on experience with Sitecore 8 and Sitecore 9.3
  • Experience with Sitecore Commerce (add-on)
  • Proficiency in C# and .NET Framework
  • Experience working with Sitecore APIs
  • Experience developing or supporting Azure web services (JavaScript-based)
  • Proven experience maintaining and upgrading legacy Sitecore platforms

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience migrating between Sitecore versions
  • Experience with Node.js migrations
  • Familiarity with Azure cloud environments and deployment best practices
  • SiteCore Certifications

Job Type: Long-time based contract Job Opportunity

Location: 100% Remote in Brazil


Job Description:


Job Description:

Specific Asks

  • 8+ years of experience with at least the last 2-3 years focused on Golang.
  • Sr developer
  • Ability to pick action items and work proactively.
  • Work independently
  • Excellent communication skills

JD:

  • 8+ Years of Software Development Experience
  • Able to apply functional and object-oriented paradigms.
  • Able to apply the SOLID principles.

  • Experience with SOA, micro-services, and/or distributed architectures
  • Able to architects systems and teaches others about appropriate software design patterns with eye towards scale and reliability
  • Stays abreast of cross-industry/domain technology solutions and able to advocate for new frameworks and technologies within their scope of influence.
  • Demonstrated ability designing and interacting with complex persisted data models.
  • Demonstrated ability to own a technical roadmap.
  • Able to both identify and improve poor performing code or database queries.
  • You are interested in continually learning and mastering new skills.
  • Able to communicate complex ideas and concepts simply and concisely.
  • You are willing to monitor and own the production services the team is responsible for and capable of leading multiple teams in troubleshooting.
  • Able to diagnose the most challenging production issues and implement the observability to provide this ability.
  • Able to lead efforts across enterprise technical teams to drive complex enterprise issues to root cause - along with a plan and measurable progress for resolution.
  • You are empathic and enjoy learning from and mentoring other engineers.

Nice to Haves

  • Open source software and dependency management
  • Object/Document data storage technologies
  • Caching and in-memory database technologies
  • Asynchronous/Multi-threaded Programming Patterns
  • Message queuing technologies/strategies

title: SAP BTP CAP Developer
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. É por isso que estamos sempre em busca de profissionais experientes e em início de carreira para se juntarem à nossa equipe.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Estamos em busca de um(a) SAP BTP CAP Developer para atuar no desenvolvimento de aplicações cloud nativas, integrações e extensões SAP utilizando o Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP) dentro da SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) para integrar nossa equipe de Nearshore.


Responsabilidade:


  • Desenvolver aplicações SAP BTP utilizando CAP (Node.js ou Java), CDS, serviços OData e lógica de negócios em cloud.
  • Criar e manter extensões side-by-side para sistemas SAP S/4HANA.
  • Projetar modelos de dados com CDS e implementar serviços, handlers e integrações.
  • Trabalhar com SAP HANA Cloud, XSUAA, Destinations, Approuter e demais serviços gerenciados da BTP.
  • Construir e manter pipelines CI/CD, testes automatizados e documentação técnica.
  • Atuar em correções, troubleshooting e performance de aplicações CAP.


Requisitos :

  • Experiência comprovada com SAP BTP e desenvolvimento com CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model).
  • Domínio de Node.js (ou Java) para desenvolvimento CAP.
  • Conhecimento em CDS, OData, Fiori Elements e annotations.
  • Experiência com SAP HANA Cloud: modelagem, consultas e performance.


Diferenciais:

  • Certificações SAP BTP (Developer, Extension Suite, Integration Suite, CAP).
  • Experiência com SAP Fiori Elements e UI5 freestyle.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Participação em projetos internacionais ou ambientes multiculturais


Formato de Trabalho: Remoto

Contratação: CLT

title: Mid/Senior Devops
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join a strategic cloud migration initiative, transitioning workloads from Azure to AWS within a structured modernization program.

This professional will play a key role in supporting the technical execution of the migration, ensuring infrastructure standardization, automation, CI/CD pipeline implementation, environment readiness, observability, and post-migration operational validation.


The project follows a Lift & Shift / Replatform approach, covering infrastructure preparation, security, networking, service equivalency mapping, migration execution, testing, stabilization, and post-cutover operational readiness.


Key Responsibilities


  • Prepare and standardize AWS environments (VPC, IAM, networking, security, logging).
  • Support migrations using AWS MGN, DMS, and SCT.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
  • Manage Infrastructure as Code with Terraform.
  • Implement monitoring and observability (CloudWatch, X-Ray, Grafana).
  • Validate application, database, and network functionality post-migration.
  • Support performance, scalability, and security testing.
  • Contribute to documentation and runbooks.


What do you need to know?


  • Cloud & Migration: AWS (EC2, EKS/ECS, S3, Aurora, VPC, ALB/NLB, Route 53, IAM, KMS), Azure (VMs, AKS, SQL, App Services)
  • DevOps & Automation: Terraform, Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps), Python/Bash/PowerShell
  • Migration Tools: AWS MGN, DMS, SCT
  • Integrations & Monitoring: Kafka, Snowflake, Elasticsearch, Datadog
  • Language: Fluent English


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the AI/R Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 5 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You

  • You’re a full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 3+ years of experience.
  • You’re a product-minded engineer with a pragmatic approach to building software.
  • You write expressive readable and maintainable code instead of just hacking together something that only works.
  • You’re curious about IoT, WiFi and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.
  • You want to learn how a business operates and get exposure beyond just writing code.


About the Role

  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Javascript and deploy it via Heroku.
  • Work with the CTO to break down large projects into small shippable slices and execute on those projects.
  • Build API integrations with 3rd party software providers
  • Create intelligent scripts and integrations to automate WiFi management tasks
  • Create and review pull requests in Github.


Why Work at StayFi?

  • You’ll be working directly with the CTO and CEO on mission critical projects.
  • You’ll get mentorship directly from the CTO and senior engineers who can help you go from being a junior or mid-level engineer to being a true master.
  • As you continue to do good work and help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to learn the ins and outs of running a sustainable and growing business.
  • You’ll be working on a small team, so you’ll get the chance to have a large impact within our company and in the vacation rental industry at large.


Location

  • Join our fully remote team from anywhere in the world. We hire globally and currently have a strong presence in the US, Latin America (Argentina, Brazil, Colombia), Europe (Netherlands, Portugal, Romania), and Africa (Egypt, Nigeria). We are looking for the best talent, regardless of geography.

title: Analista de empréstimo
description:
About Monee

At Monee, we believe that every team member is essential to our success — and that diversity of perspectives and experiences is key to driving our business and advancing our purpose of changing the world for the better.

Being part of our team means growing within a fast-paced and agile culture. If you love taking on big responsibilities and doing what has never been done before, Monee is the place for you.

Here, you’ll face meaningful challenges, collaborate with a diverse team, and help shape the future of the fintech industry in Brazil — creating a positive impact in the lives of millions.

Work Model

We adopt a hybrid work model, this model allows people to adjust their work environment according to their personal needs, while promoting collaboration and interaction in the office.



What will be your mission?

Planning and execution of projects related to credit products, including participation in and development of initiatives focused on identifying business opportunities, conducting in-depth analyses, and implementing new solutions. Creation of strategic initiatives aimed at driving growth and cost reduction. Leadership of workstreams within high-impact projects in a fast-paced environment, ensuring concrete and tangible deliverables. Ongoing interaction with teams across different areas and countries, as well as direct collaboration with multiple internal stakeholders and external partners.


What will your day-to-day be like?

  • Build and launch new credit products (with focus on consumer) while monitoring the results of current product portfolio;
  • Identify business opportunities, conduct in-depth analysis, and implement new solutions;
  • Prepare and present business cases to both local and international audiences
  • Own and deliver strategic and tactical initiatives to drive growth and cost reduction;
  • Lead workstreams in high-impact projects in a fast-paced environment, with concrete and tangible deliverables;
  • Interact with teams from different areas and countries. Work closely with the SG SeaMoney team.
  • High exposure to top management.



What you need to take on the challenge:

  • Experience in Credit Products for Consumers (BNPL, Personal Loan, Secured Credit etc.)
  • Advanced English (speaking, reading, and writing is mandatory);
  • Hands-on profile, ability to think strategically;
  • Data-drive profile, being capable of dealing with complex models and analysis;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with cross-functional teams and external

stakeholders;

  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Benefits:
  • Medical and dental care, extended to dependents;
  • Partnership with Gympass and TotalPass;
  • Flexible meal/food vouchers;
  • Transportation vouchers, mobility vouchers or on-site parking;
  • Flexible benefits;
  • Zenklub;
  • Discretionary annual bonus, linked to performance.

COME MAKE HISTORY WITH US.

WHAT MAKES YOU UNIQUE, MAKES US BETTER!

title: Senior API Engineer (NodeJS, TS, SDUI)
description:
About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role summary:

Lead the design and operation of APIs that power Server-Driven UI for Flutter clients while owning backend services across the stack. You’ll design stable UI contracts and compose client payloads, be comfortable diving into other backend codebases to implement features and fix production issues, participate in the on-call rotation to keep services healthy and low-latency, and drive team capability for SDUI.


Key responsibilities:

  • Design and implement robust RESTful APIs for SDUI, auth, and rate limiting.
  • Implement composition/templating logic that returns client-ready UI payloads with capability-aware fallbacks.
  • Champion SDUI capability across the team: coach engineers, run hands-on workshops, create onboarding/docs, and promote SDUI best practices.
  • Work across multiple backend repositories: add features, refactor, and maintain code quality.
  • Operate production services: own SLAs, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and participate in on-call rotation.
  • Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing).
  • Build and maintain CI/CD, testing, and observability (metrics, tracing, logs, dashboards).
  • Integrate personalization, experimentation hooks, and feature flags into the delivery flow.
  • Collaborate closely with mobile/web teams to define contracts and client compatibility.
  • Mentor peers, lead design reviews, and drive API and schema governance and backward-compatibility practices.


Required skills & experience:

  • 7+ years building production microservices and APIs.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with active participation in team ceremonies and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design.
  • Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) experience, including effective use of abstraction and dependency injection patterns to build modular, testable, and maintainable backend systems.
  • Hands-on development in TypeScript for backend services.
  • Proven RESTful API design and contract experience.
  • Solid experience with databases and caching technologies, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis, with an understanding of data modeling, query performance, and cache strategies.
  • Strong with AWS (API Gateway/Lambda or ECS/EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents).
  • Experience with containerization using Docker (image build, Docker Compose, registries, running services in containers).
  • Strong testing experience, including automated testing and manual verification.
  • Experience with production support: alerting, runbooks, incident management, and on-call duties.
  • Familiar with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, etc.).
  • Good spoken English


Nice to have:

  • Terraform or other IaC for managing AWS resources.
  • Experience instrumenting endpoints and surfacing behavior in analytics platforms such as Amplitude (event schemas, dashboards, alerts).
  • Experience using Statsig, Grafana, and Sentry for experimentation, dashboards, error tracking, and incident diagnostics.
  • Protobuf experience (service/event schema management via service-protos).
  • Background in personalization/experimentation systems.
  • Hands-on development in Python for backend services.


Hiring signals:

  • Examples of evolving APIs without breaking clients and measurable reliability/performance improvements.
  • Proven track record of mentoring and up-skilling engineers—especially enabling teams to adopt and own SDUI patterns.
  • Evidence of effective on-call ownership: resolved incidents, improved runbooks/alerts, postmortems.
  • Code that shows strong testing, observability, and cross-repo contributions.


Perks:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work
  • Flexible PTO
  • Global offices
  • Fun, positive, collaborative environment!



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Omnistudio Developer
description:
Salesforce Developer – OmniStudio & Communications Cloud


The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and delivering scalable and high‑quality Salesforce solutions within a digital transformation project in the telecommunications industry. You will work with OmniStudio, Salesforce Communications Cloud, and core Salesforce technologies to build optimized business processes. You will test your code, ensure quality through best practices, and collaborate in Agile environments.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement scalable solutions using OmniStudio (OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures).
  • Build and configure applications within Salesforce Communications Cloud (formerly Vlocity CPQ/EPC).
  • Participate in the development of telecom business processes such as quote‑to‑order , customer onboarding , and service provisioning .
  • Write clear, maintainable, and high‑quality code using Apex , LWC , and Salesforce configuration tools.
  • Support integration development using REST, SOAP, JSON, XML .
  • Collaborate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, estimation, and reviews.
  • Perform unit testing and provide support throughout SIT and UAT cycles.
  • Document technical specifications, solution designs, and deployment guidelines.
  • Contribute to CI/CD workflows using tools such as Copado, Git, Jenkins, Ant .


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands‑on experience with Salesforce development .
  • 2+ years of experience with OmniStudio development.
  • Strong experience with:
  • OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures
  • Salesforce configuration, Apex , and LWC
  • Salesforce Communications Cloud (Vlocity CPQ & EPC)
  • Experience integrating systems using REST/SOAP APIs and working with JSON/XML formats.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Copado, Git, Jenkins, Ant).
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments (SAFe Agile preferred).
  • Strong debugging, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.


Preferred Certifications

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I
  • OmniStudio Developer Certification
  • Salesforce Industries CPQ Developer (nice to have)

title: SiteCore Developer
description:
We are looking for a Sitecore Developer Developer for a 100% Remote, 5 month +, 1099 contract


Location: Brazil or Colombia, South America (work remote supporting US based client/project)

Employment Type: Contract Work, 40 hours weekly


Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Sitecore Developer to design, develop, and support enterprise-level CMS and commerce platforms. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Sitecore 8 and 9.x , C# , and the .NET Framework , with a proven ability to build scalable, high-performance solutions in complex enterprise environments.

This role involves working on both modernization initiatives and ongoing support of legacy Sitecore implementations while ensuring code quality, scalability, and system reliability.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop Sitecore MVC solutions for enterprise CMS and commerce platforms
  • Build and maintain custom Sitecore APIs and integrations
  • Support and modernize legacy Sitecore environments
  • Ensure application performance, scalability, and code quality best practices
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver robust digital solutions
  • Contribute to Sitecore version upgrades and platform migrations


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Extensive experience developing Sitecore MVC solutions in enterprise environments
  • Strong hands-on experience with Sitecore 8 and Sitecore 9.3
  • Experience with Sitecore Commerce (add-on)
  • Proficiency in C# and .NET Framework
  • Experience working with Sitecore APIs
  • Experience developing or supporting Azure web services (JavaScript-based)
  • Proven experience maintaining and upgrading legacy Sitecore platforms

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience migrating between Sitecore versions
  • Experience with Node.js migrations
  • Familiarity with Azure cloud environments and deployment best practices
  • SiteCore Certifications

title: Arquiteto Soluções - GCP
description:
A Atos é uma empresa líder mundial em transformação digital, oferecendo serviços de transação de alta tecnologia, consultoria, integração de sistemas, cloud e serviços gerenciados. Além disso, anunciada como parceira mundial de TI nos Jogos Olímpicos e Paraolímpicos!


Presente em mais de 70 países e com aproximadamente 100.000 especialistas ao redor do mundo, nossa empresa está no novo ranking Digital 100 da Forbes, uma lista das principais empresas de capital aberto que moldam o mundo digital nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (TI), hardware, mídia, e-commerce e telecomunicações.


Estamos em busca de um Arquiteto de Soluções com sólida experiência em Google Cloud Platform (GCP) , migração para cloud e gestão e modernização de aplicações. Este profissional será responsável por desenhar soluções utilizando ferramentas GCP (como BigQuery, Vertex AI e Gemini). Você atuará em projetos estratégicos de transformação digital, projetando soluções escaláveis para gerar valor a partir de dados e IA em ambientes corporativos complexos.

Além de forte expertise técnica, buscamos um perfil colaborativo, proativo e orientado a resultados, com capacidade de se envolver com equipes de negócios, arquitetura e engenharia.



Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar e apoiar a implementação de pipelines de dados e fluxos de machine learning usando ferramentas nativas do GCP (BigQuery, BigQuery ML, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, etc.).
  • Identificar modelos preditivos e generativos apropriados usando BigQuery ML, Vertex AI e Gemini para resolver desafios de negócios dos clientes.
  • Projetar soluções para criar, treinar, monitorar e manter modelos em produção com foco em desempenho, escalabilidade e governança.
  • Colaborar de perto com engenheiros de dados, cientistas de dados e stakeholders de negócio para entender requisitos e propor soluções eficazes.
  • Projetar e apoiar a implementação de soluções que automatizem processos de ingestão, transformação e análise de dados, acelerando a entrega de insights de negócio.
  • Documentar soluções técnicas e apoiar o repasse de conhecimento para equipes internas e clientes.
  • Contribuir para a evolução das melhores práticas de arquitetura de dados e IA no GCP. Espera-se que você faça a mediação entre áreas de negócio do cliente e equipes técnicas.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação ou Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas relacionadas.



Benefícios:

  • Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação
  • Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos
  • Plano odontológico
  • Programa de remuneração variável
  • Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade
  • Wellhub (Gympass)
  • Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos
  • Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional
  • Seguro de vida
  • Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa)
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas)
  • Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas)
  • Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)
  • Programa de treinamentos internos e externos
  • Universidade corporativa (E-learning com milhares de cursos disponíveis gratuitamente)
  • Espaço Saúde (suporte com atendimento médico - presencial ou online - para os funcionários e seus familiares e contamos também com os programas de bem-estar e qualidade de vida)
  • Terapia online
  • Massoterapia
  • Programa de acompanhamento à gestante (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras ou cônjuges)
  • Programa Minha Nova Parceria de Confiança (para colaboradores e cônjuges. Válido também para filhos adotivos) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro
  • Day off no seu aniversário
  • Parceria com a Samsung (descontos na compra de diversos produtos)
  • Bônus de indicação para nossas vagas (conforme política interna)
  • Jubileu (premiação personalizada por tempo de empresa)
  • Accolade (Programa de reconhecimento)
